svg.title: Extra weight lost beyond placebo (percentage points)
svg.desc: Percentage points of body weight lost beyond placebo, everyone randomized counted. Without diabetes: survodutide 6.0 mg 7.6 (SYNCHRONIZE-1), Wegovy 12.4 (STEP 1), Zepbound 17.8 (SURMOUNT-1), retatrutide 12 mg 21.0 (TRIUMPH-1). With type 2 diabetes: survodutide 5.9 (SYNCHRONIZE-2), Wegovy 6.2 (STEP 2), Zepbound 11.6 (SURMOUNT-2), retatrutide 13.8 (TRIUMPH-2). Survodutide and retatrutide are investigational.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
